titles.romaji: Ajin ga Osuki nan desu ne♡
titles.native: 亜人がお好きなんですね♡

description:
Episode 1

Koisuru Kuroyagi
The owner of the mansion was a strict man and always gave a cold response. One night, Maya is seen by him shaving her hair. The owner had a peculiar sexual fetish and was sexually aroused by shaving women's pubic hair. Maya had been in love with him since she came to the mansion, so she pulled up the hem of her skirt to show her pubic hair and asked the owner, who couldn't hide his excitement, to shave her, and he readily agreed. She lathered up shaving soap and worked her way from her waist to her thighs, around her mucous membrane and down to her pubic hair. Maya was so moved by the sight of herself that she wanted to continue.

Futarikiri no Orca Show: Kono Koi ni Oborete
Lucca is performing in a spectacular aqua show. Recently, she has been losing focus and making mistakes. The reason is clear - she is in love with Masaki, who supports her. In order to reciprocate her feelings, the other members lie to the two and introduce them to each other in an empty venue. After confessing their feelings to each other, they make love to each other. Emotionally excited, the two fall into the pool, but ascend to heaven as their bodies sink.

Episode 2

Kyuusekkin!!: Koi wa Oshiire no Naka de
That day when he hid in the closet with his childhood friend... Puru fell in love. A few years later, he sees a woman talking intimately with his childhood friend and becomes so jealous that he misses school for several days. His childhood friend comes to visit him out of concern, but when he tells her what happened, it's all a misunderstanding on Puru's part. Time passes since the day his mouth was covered by tentacles in the closet, and he finally realizes that their feelings are mutual. The two fall in love and draw close to each other.

Kemono Michi
A boy wanders into an alleyway where it is rumored that a dog-like beast lives. When Moka opens the door, the boy stands frozen, his face stiffens, and he wets himself. She invites him into her house and takes a bath with him, and the boy's crotch becomes swollen, so she decides to treat it. Once, twice... and then he begs for more. Pleasurable things await him in the alleyway he has wandered into.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)
